paragraphs: According to Al Jazeera, cricketer Cameron Bancroft has claimed that the entire Australian team was aware of the ball-tampering plot during the infamous 'Sandpapergate' incident. Bancroft stated that he previously lied to protect Cricket Australia's official investigation.
BBC Sport noted that these explosive allegations have reignited intense questions and discussions regarding who was involved and what various players and officials said about the scandal at the time.

sources.used_text: As Cameron Bancroft's explosive allegations raise more questions about the sandpaper scandal, BBC Sport looks at who was there and what they have said since.

title: Tatjana Smith Switches Allegiance to the Netherlands
summary: South Africa ordered an investigation into its swimming federation following an Olympic champion's departure.
paragraphs: According to France 24, South Africa's sports minister ordered an official inquiry into the national swimming federation following the decision of the country's most decorated Olympic athlete, Tatjana Smith, to switch her competitive allegiance to the Netherlands.

The two-time Olympic champion announced her departure in an emotional social media video, prompting renewed domestic scrutiny over athlete support structures within South African sports, as reported by France 24.
